== Japanese printing source review ==
Original Japanese title, lore, game text, subtype, destiny, title marks and icons were read from [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Counter-Assault-PSA-20261106.jpg|the original photograph]]. Rarity is from the Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 Japanese checklist, p.97. English reading aids were prepared by ChatGPT against this photograph and [[:File:Premiere-D-counterassault.gif|the English printed face]]. Both printed texts spend 1 Force to cancel a drain at one location, draw destiny for the opponent's characters, starships and vehicles there, and compare that total with the opponent's power. The Japanese lore emphasizes immediate regrouping and reversing the situation; the English describes tactical training to regroup and mount a surprise counterattack. No Credits field is printed.
